name: User Rating
description: Imports an IMDb "Your Ratings" export into UserData.Rating and reports every rated title that is not in the library, sorted by your own score and exportable as CSV. Also surfaces the rating in the stock web UI: sort, poster badge, editable detail score. No jellyfin-web fork. https://github.com/crack666/jellyfin-plugin-userrating
overview: Import your IMDb ratings, and see which rated titles are missing from your library

versions.changelog:
- Fixes the white "Unexpected Application Error" screen on Jellyfin 12.3: the personal-rating
  sort emptied a React-owned icon in the sort menu, and the next render tore the app down.
- Personal-rating sort works again on 12.3. The server now sorts SortBy=UserRating itself, so
  it no longer depends on the web app fetching its library through window.fetch.
- Picking "Personal rating" applies immediately instead of only after leaving the view.

- Jellyfin 12: target net10.0 / ABI 12.0.0.0, IUserManager.GetUsers(). 10.11 stays on 1.2.0.1.
- Web: Personal rating in the 12 Sort menu; harvest ratings if the first /Items fetch races the script.
- Web: sort cards in the grid (JF12 has no itemsContainer.refreshItems); hook client.js before the first fetch.
- Web: Personal-rating sort keeps the native asc/desc arrow and toggles direction on a second click.

- No functional change. First release published through the plugin repository, so the
  install and update path can be verified end to end.

- Personal rating can stand in for CriticRating and/or CommunityRating, so native clients (Android, FireTV, webOS, Chromecast) show and sort by it.
- Two independent toggles, response-only, nothing written to the database.
- Rating writes moved to the current POST /UserItems/{itemId}/UserData route.
- Settings text translated into all 29 bundled locales.
